Overview of Canary Islands Region (Islas Canarias)

Canary Islands Region (Islas Canarias) is located in the Canary Islands region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Mount Teide National Park (Tenerife), Timanfaya Volcanic National Park (Lanzarote), Maspalomas Dunes & Roque Nublo (Gran Canaria), La Gomera Garajonay laurel forest.

RegionCanary Islands
Capital citySanta Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas
Cities & municipalities38
Primary transport hubSanta Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Canary Islands Region

Direct flights to Tenerife (TFS/TFN), Gran Canaria (LPA), Lanzarote (ACE) and Fuerteventura (FUE); Fred. Olsen & Armas inter-island ferries. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canary Islands

When visiting cities across Canary Islands, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Papas arrugadas con mojo picón y verde
  • Gofio escaldado
  • Queso Majorero & Almogrote
  • Sancocho Canario
  • Malvasía volcanic wines of Lanzarote

Best time to visit Canary Islands

Best time to visit Canary Islands: Year-round (eternal spring 20–26°C).
